claims.subject: Son design-procedure feasibility checks
claims.object: min pintle-nozzle area below center-gap area; subsonic injection with blowout limits; bounded vaporization distance; chamber diameter larger than injector module diameter
claims.statement: Son et al.'s iterative design procedure checks that the minimum area of the pintle nozzle is lower than the center gap area, injection velocities are below the speed of sound with further blowout restrictions, vaporization distance stays within a reasonable range, and the calculated chamber diameter is larger than the injector module diameter.
claims.quote: chamber diameter should be larger than the injector module diameter
